lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Lesser Archon FFXIV Elite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Archon FFXIV Elite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Archon FFXIV Elites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Archon FFXIV Elite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Archon FFXIV Elite
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Archon FFXIV Elite bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Archon FFXIV Elite
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Archon FFXIV Elite — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Archon FFXIV Elite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Archon FFXIV Elite the Revered
star_6.appearance: Archon FFXIV Elite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Archon FFXIV Elites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Gray Slime — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Gray Slime is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Gray Slime the Revered
star_6.appearance: Gray Slime now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Gray Slimes have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Apex Gray Slime
star_7.appearance: The final form. Gray Slime stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Gray Slime is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The First Ocean" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Spawn Yellow Slime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Yellow Slime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Yellow Slimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Kindling Yellow Slime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Storm Tundra Guardians in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Kindling Storm Tundra Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Storm Tundra Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Storm Tundra Guardian bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Storm Tundra Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Storm Tundra Guardian — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Storm Tundra Guardian is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Storm Tundra Guardian the True
star_6.appearance: Storm Tundra Guardian now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Storm Tundra Guardians have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Sublime Storm Tundra Guardian

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Elemental-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Spawn War Mountain Spirit
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of War Mountain Spirit. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. War Mountain Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling War Mountain Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Bud Giant Common VII
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Giant Common VII. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Giant Common VIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Giant Common VII
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Young Sunken Pink Slime Senior

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Sunken Pink Slime Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Sunken Pink Slime Senior

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Newborn Swamp Critter
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Swamp Critter. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Swamp Critters in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Swamp Critter
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Pup Ancient The Lich King Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ancient The Lich King Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Ancient The Lich King Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Kindling Ancient The Lich King Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Ancient The Lich King Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Ancient The Lich King Fragment bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Ancient The Lich King Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Ancient The Lich King Fragment — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Ancient The Lich King Fragment is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Ancient The Lich King Fragment the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Ancient The Lich King Fragment now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Ancient The Lich King Fragments have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Eternal Ancient The Lich King Fragment
star_7.appearance: The final form. Ancient The Lich King Fragment stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Ancient The Lich King Fragment is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The First Ocean" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Ash Gray Slime VII
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ash Gray Slime VII. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Ash Gray Slime VIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Ash Gray Slime VII
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Ash Gray Slime VII
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Ash Gray Slime VII bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Hatchling Sunken WoW Gnoll

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Newborn Scraggly Black Slime Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scraggly Black Slime Corrupted. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Scraggly Black Slime Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Scraggly Black Slime Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Newborn Shard Healer Slime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shard Healer Slime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Shard Healer Slimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Shard Healer Slime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Shard Healer Slime
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Shard Healer Slime bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Shard Healer Slime
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Seed Rotten Kobold Common
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rotten Kobold Common. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Kindling Rotten Kobold Common

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. WoW Skeleton Scout Juniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form WoW Skeleton Scout Junior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: WoW Skeleton Scout Junior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. WoW Skeleton Scout Junior bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked WoW Skeleton Scout Junior
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: WoW Skeleton Scout Junior — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class WoW Skeleton Scout Junior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: WoW Skeleton Scout Junior the Last
star_6.appearance: WoW Skeleton Scout Junior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent WoW Skeleton Scout Juniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Final WoW Skeleton Scout Junior
star_7.appearance: The final form. WoW Skeleton Scout Junior stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of WoW Skeleton Scout Junior is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The First Ocean" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Hatchling Ragged Tundra Critter V
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ragged Tundra Critter V. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Ragged Tundra Critter Vs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Ragged Tundra Critter V
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Young WoW Kobold Feral
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of WoW Kobold Feral. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. WoW Kobold Ferals in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Emerging WoW Kobold Feral
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Hatchling Primordial Cave Spirit

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Primordial Cave Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Stirring Primordial Cave Spirit

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Seed Hallowed Slime Sovereign Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hallowed Slime Sovereign Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Hallowed Slime Sovereign Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling Hallowed Slime Sovereign Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Seed Healslime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Healslime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Healslimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling Healslime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Healslime
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Healslime bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Healslime
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Healslime — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Healslime is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

star_6.name: Healslime the First
star_6.appearance: Healslime now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Healslimes have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Sublime Healslime
star_7.appearance: The final form. Healslime stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Healslime is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The First Ocean" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Wandering WoW Undead Scout Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Pup Titan N'Zoth Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Titan N'Zoth Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Titan N'Zoth Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Titan N'Zoth Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Siege Liquid Metal Slime

base_chain.name: Hatchling Supreme King Metal Slime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Supreme King Metal Slime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Supreme King Metal Slimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Supreme King Metal Slime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Young Omega WoW Boss Minor

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Sacred Swamp Spirit
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Sacred Swamp Spirit — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Sacred Swamp Spirit is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Sacred Swamp Spirit the Last
star_6.appearance: Sacred Swamp Spirit now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Sacred Swamp Spirits have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Newborn Rotten Black Slime Greater
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rotten Black Slime Greater. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Rotten Black Slime Greaters in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising Rotten Black Slime Greater
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Newborn Risen Slime Sovereign Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Risen Slime Sovereign Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Risen Slime Sovereign Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Risen Slime Sovereign Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Black Slime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Black Slime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Black Slimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Black Slime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Wisp Blue Slime IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Blue Slime IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Blue Slime IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Blue Slime IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Seed Rune Metal King Slime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Rune Metal King Slime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Rune Metal King Slimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Kindling Rune Metal King Slime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rune Metal King Slime
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Rune Metal King Slime bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded WoW Trogg Feral
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: WoW Trogg Feral — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class WoW Trogg Feral is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

star_6.name: WoW Trogg Feral Transcendent
star_6.appearance: WoW Trogg Feral now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent WoW Trogg Ferals have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Wisp Primordial Ragnaros Full
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Primordial Ragnaros Full. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Primordial Ragnaros Fulls in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Primordial Ragnaros Full
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Wisp Abyss Dullahan
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Abyss Dullahan. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Abyss Dullahans in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Abyss Dullahan
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Hatchling Gale WoW Ghoul Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Gale WoW Ghoul Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Gale WoW Ghoul Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Gale WoW Ghoul Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.name: Spawn WoW Orc Minor Beta
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of WoW Orc Minor Beta. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Emerging WoW Orc Minor Beta
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Wisp Waning Slime Knight Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Waning Slime Knight Ancient. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Waning Slime Knight Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Waning Slime Knight Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Waning Slime Knight Ancient
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Waning Slime Knight Ancient bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Waning Slime Knight Ancient
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
