tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Newborn Craven King Slime Scout Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Craven King Slime Scout Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Craven King Slime Scout Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Craven King Slime Scout Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Craven King Slime Scout Minor
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Craven King Slime Scout Minor bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Craven King Slime Scout Minor
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Craven King Slime Scout Minor — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Craven King Slime Scout Minor is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Craven King Slime Scout Minor the Last
star_6.appearance: Craven King Slime Scout Minor now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Craven King Slime Scout Minors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Final Craven King Slime Scout Minor
star_7.appearance: The final form. Craven King Slime Scout Minor stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Craven King Slime Scout Minor is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The First Ocean" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Pitted Swamp Guardians in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: First-Form Pitted Swamp Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Pitted Swamp Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Pitted Swamp Guardian bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Pitted Swamp Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Pitted Swamp Guardian — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Pitted Swamp Guardian is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Pitted Swamp Guardian Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Pitted Swamp Guardian now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Pitted Swamp Guardians have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Legend Pitted Swamp Guardian
star_7.appearance: The final form. Pitted Swamp Guardian stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Pitted Swamp Guardian is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The First Ocean" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: WoW Centaur Feral
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. WoW Centaur Feral bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted WoW Centaur Feral
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: WoW Centaur Feral — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class WoW Centaur Feral is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: WoW Centaur Feral of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: WoW Centaur Feral now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent WoW Centaur Ferals have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

base_chain.name: Spawn Wrath Mountain Spirit

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Wrath Mountain Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Kindling Wrath Mountain Spirit

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Seed Juggernaut Slime Sovereign Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Juggernaut Slime Sovereign Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Juggernaut Slime Sovereign Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Juggernaut Slime Sovereign Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Wisp Fallen Ragnaros Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Fallen Ragnaros Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Fallen Ragnaros Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Fallen Ragnaros Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Venomous-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Plague WoW Onyxia Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Plague WoW Onyxia Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Plague WoW Onyxia Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Plague WoW Onyxia Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Plague WoW Onyxia Scout
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Plague WoW Onyxia Scout bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Dust Green Slime Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dust Green Slime Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Dust Green Slime Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Dust Green Slime Senior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Bud Obsidian WoW Hakkar Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Obsidian WoW Hakkar Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Obsidian WoW Hakkar Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Obsidian WoW Hakkar Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Young Sludge Slime Basic Beta
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sludge Slime Basic Beta. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Sludge Slime Basic Betas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Kindling Sludge Slime Basic Beta
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Serpentine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Serpent Common IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Serpent Common IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Serpent Common IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Serpent Common IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Serpent Common IV
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Serpent Common IV bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.

base_chain.name: Bud Archon Baramos Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Archon Baramos Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Archon Baramos Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Archon Baramos Fragment

base_chain.name: Newborn King Slime Scout

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. King Slime Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Rising King Slime Scout

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Draconic-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Bud Shroud Dragon Wyrmling Elite
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shroud Dragon Wyrmling Elite. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Shroud Dragon Wyrmling Elites in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Emerging Shroud Dragon Wyrmling Elite
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned WoW Quilboar
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: WoW Quilboar — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class WoW Quilboar is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: WoW Quilboar of the Apex
star_6.appearance: WoW Quilboar now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent WoW Quilboars have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

base_chain.name: Bud Shard Dragon Wyrmling Cursed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shard Dragon Wyrmling Cursed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Shard Dragon Wyrmling Curseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Emerging Shard Dragon Wyrmling Cursed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Lesser Dragon Wyrmling Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dragon Wyrmling Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Dragon Wyrmling Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Dragon Wyrmling Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Lesser Vile Green Slime Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Vile Green Slime Alpha. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Vile Green Slime Alphas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Vile Green Slime Alpha

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Pup Nemesis N'Zoth Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Nemesis N'Zoth Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Nemesis N'Zoth Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Nemesis N'Zoth Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Bud Dread Desert Spirit

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Dread Desert Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Dread Desert Spirit

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Lesser Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VIs have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: God-King Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI
star_7.appearance: The final form. Twilight Dragon Wyrmling VI stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Forsaken C'Thun Fragment

base_chain.name: Young Infernal C'Thun Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Infernal C'Thun Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Infernal C'Thun Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Infernal C'Thun Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Slime Knight Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Slime Knight Awakened. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Slime Knight Awakeneds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Slime Knight Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Slime Knight Awakened

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Young Hellborn N'Zoth Fragment
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hellborn N'Zoth Fragment. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Hellborn N'Zoth Fragments in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Hellborn N'Zoth Fragment
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Wisp Infinite Rhapthorne Dark

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Infinite Rhapthorne Darks in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Rising Infinite Rhapthorne Dark
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Newborn Crowned WoW Boss Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crowned WoW Boss Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Crowned WoW Boss Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Crowned WoW Boss Minor

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. base_chain.name: Lesser Filthy Healslime Tamed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Filthy Healslime Tamed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Filthy Healslime Tameds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Filthy Healslime Tamed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Shroud Swamp Guardian Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shroud Swamp Guardian Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Shroud Swamp Guardian Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Shroud Swamp Guardian Minor

base_chain.name: Stirring Pale WoW Orc Minor Elite

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Bud Umbral Healer Slime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Umbral Healer Slime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Umbral Healer Slimes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Awakened Umbral Healer Slime

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Elemental-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Wisp Primordial Mountain Spirit
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Primordial Mountain Spirit. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Primordial Mountain Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Rising Primordial Mountain Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Primordial Mountain Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Primordial Mountain Spirit bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Spawn Craven Liquid Slime I
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Craven Liquid Slime I. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Craven Liquid Slime Is in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Craven Liquid Slime I
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Hatchling Lord FE Elite

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Rising Lord FE Elite

tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Jagged WoW Murloc
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Jagged WoW Murloc. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Jagged WoW Murlocs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Jagged WoW Murloc
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Jagged WoW Murloc
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Jagged WoW Murloc bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Jagged WoW Murloc
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Jagged WoW Murloc — Leviathan Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Leviathan path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Jagged WoW Murloc is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Elder Realm. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Jagged WoW Murloc the Last
star_6.appearance: Jagged WoW Murloc now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Jagged WoW Murlocs have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

star_7.name: Origin Jagged WoW Murloc
star_7.appearance: The final form. Jagged WoW Murloc stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Meager WoW Orc Minor Ancients in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Meager WoW Orc Minor Ancient

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Slimoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Metal Slime VI
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Metal Slime VI. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Metal Slime VIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Metal Slime VI
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Waning Liquid Slime Corrupted

base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Waning Liquid Slime Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Elder Realm-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Leviathan Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Waning Liquid Slime Corrupted of the Apex

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + First Tide's Echo

lore_summary: A creature of the Elder Realm, aligned with Primal energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Primal tamers are called Tide-Speakers. Bond is formed through patience — sitting with the creature for 30 in-game days before it will acknowledge you.

base_chain.name: Seed Archon Onyxia Full
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Archon Onyxia Full. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Archon Onyxia Fulls in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Archon Onyxia Full
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Elder Realm. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Archon Onyxia Full
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Archon Onyxia Full bears the aesthetic of Elder Realm — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Primal crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Elder Realm. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Clear  the first lives still live. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Archon Onyxia Full

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Leviathan Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Elder Realm, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Newborn Doom Sea Spirit

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Doom Sea Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rising Doom Sea Spirit

base_chain.name: Fledgling Gray Slime IV
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Gray Slime IV. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Gray Slime IVs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Gray Slime IV
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Primal — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Newborn Swamp Tundra Critter
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Swamp Tundra Critter. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Swamp Tundra Critters in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Swamp Tundra Critter

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Wisp Silver WoW Kel'Thuzad Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Silver WoW Kel'Thuzad Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Elder Realm. Silver WoW Kel'Thuzad Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Silver WoW Kel'Thuzad Scout

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start
